phase_0.boundary_condition: The terminal anchor (TANCH) that seals the IMASM word, enforcing the cyclic pairing of all split/fuse frames and containing the entire control-flow closure within a single, self-contained structural boundary.

⊢.justification: The uninitialized state (00) before any glyph is imscribed, representing the empty set of structural constraints.

⊣.justification: The closed boundary (⊣) that defines the extent of the system, ensuring all internal forks are resolved or explicitly held open within the word.

≻.justification: Directed transformation (≻) representing the forward flow of control or the advance of the phase in the spectral word.

≺.justification: Contravariant transformation (≺) representing the reverse flow, descent in the lattice, or the parity flip in the F-arm.

⋈.justification: Sequential chaining (⋈) of morphisms, binding distinct operations into a coherent structural path.

⊙.justification: Self-reference (⊙) where the element is itself, acting as the neutral element for expansion and the wildcard for no-distinction.

∈.justification: The opening of a state into two arms (∈), representing a genuine decision point or the separation of constructive truth and falsity.

∋.justification: The rejoining of arms (∋) into a single B4 verdict, resolving the fork via Belnap join.

⊤.justification: The affirmative arm (⊤), representing proven or established states within the T-branch.

⊥.justification: The negative arm (⊥), representing refuted or negated states within the F-branch.

⊞.justification: Holding both truth and falsity simultaneously (⊞), a contradiction kept live as a legitimate resolution (B-state).

⊡.justification: Permanent, append-only record (⊡), fixing the state in a way that cannot be undone, such as a measurement record.

steps.domain_action: Establish the terminal anchor, defining the closed boundary of the IMASM word.
Reinforce the boundary, ensuring the cyclic pairing context is fully sealed.
Imscribe the identity, establishing the self-referential core of the system.
Open the first fork, splitting the state into T and F arms for evaluation.
Evaluate the T-arm, affirming the constructive truth of the forward morphism.
Apply the forward morphism, advancing the state toward the target.
Compose the forward morphism with the next operation, chaining the transformation.
Evaluate the F-arm, refuting the constructive falsity of the reverse morphism.
Apply the reverse morphism, descending the state or flipping parity.
Re-evaluate the T-arm, confirming the truth of the composed path.
Re-evaluate the F-arm, confirming the falsity of the reverse path.
Engage the paradice, holding both the truth and falsity simultaneously in the B-state.
Imscribe the identity again, maintaining the self-reference through the engagement.
Apply another forward morphism, continuing the structural advance.
Compose the new forward morphism, extending the chain.
Apply the reverse morphism, completing the descent cycle.
Fuse the arms, rejoining the T and F evaluations into a single B4 verdict.
Engage the paradice at the fused level, holding the contradiction live.
Fix the result, recording the verdict as a permanent, append-only entry.
